title: A Better Spur Should Start From Each Objective
abstract: arXiv:2609.08211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) often suffers from sparse rewards, reward conflicts, and late-stage reward tug-of-war, causing traditional linear scalarization to experience severe metric oscillations. To address optimization conflicts among multiple objectives in real-world deployment scenarios, we propose Multi-Marginal Preference Optimization (MMPO), a fine-grained framework that intervenes at the data, gradient, and constraint levels rather than relying on coarse-grained global scalarization. Specifically, MMPO performs exposure debiasing to mitigate sparse and biased rewards, applies priority-aware orthogonal projection to decouple conflicting gradients, and introduces self-prompted gradient constraints to prevent dominant objectives from overwhelming weaker ones. translated_title: 更好的驱动力应始于每个目标
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的多目标强化学习（MORL）常常受到稀疏奖励、奖励冲突以及后期奖励“拉锯战”问题的困扰，导致传统的线性标量化方法出现严重的指标震荡。为了解决现实部署场景中多个目标之间的优化冲突，我们提出了多边际偏好优化（MMPO），这是一种细粒度的框架，在数据、梯度和约束三个层面进行干预，而不是依赖于粗粒度的全局标量化。具体而言，MMPO 通过曝光去偏来缓解稀疏和有偏的奖励，应用优先级感知的正交投影来解耦相互冲突的梯度，并引入自我提示的梯度约束以防止主导目标淹没较弱势的目标。在真实电商数据集上的实验表明，MMPO 提高了训练稳定性，并在冲突目标上持续取得更优的性能。
tldr: 提出了多边际偏好优化（MMPO）框架，通过曝光去偏、优先级感知正交投影和自我提示梯度约束，在数据、梯度和约束三个层面细粒度地解决多目标强化学习中的目标冲突问题，显著提升训练稳定性与性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Multi-Marginal Preference Optimization (MMPO), a fine-grained framework that resolves multi-objective conflicts in real-world MORL by intervening at data, gradient, and constraint levels through exposure debiasing, priority-aware orthogonal projection, and self-prompted gradient constraints, achieving more stable training and consistently better performance.
